_comment: Shared test vectors for Quick-Add `@` day-token resolution (issue #211). Asserted by BOTH frontend/oci/src/dateSuggest.test.ts and backend/oci/tests/test_date_phrase.py so the two independent resolvers cannot drift on the vocabulary they share. Only phrases that BOTH resolvers must agree on live here — tokens unique to the frontend grammar (`weekend`, `next-week`, same-weekday-as-today) are covered by frontend-only tests. `phrase` is the text after the `@` sigil; `localDate` is the client's local calendar date; `expected` is the resolved all-day due date (UTC midnight, ISO-8601 with a `Z`).
